messages:
maya: quick pass after testing the compact regression list. a few accessibility & microcopy items to decide on before i hand to eng.

sam: drop the prototype?

maya: https://figma.com/file/xyz123/compact-regressions (page: compact-list-v3)

leila: high level: love the density but some items rely on color alone and keyboard focus order feels off when opening the diff preview.

maya: specifics: 1) diff preview header (file name + status) currently uses bold + color. we should add an icon (check/x) and a visible focus outline when row is focused. suggestion: 2px outline with system focus color.

kevin: outline fine, but make sure it doesn't clash with selected-row state. perhaps use inset outline for focused state and shadow for selected.

leila: 2) keyboard expansion: hitting Enter while a row is focused should expand the diff inline and focus the first interactive element inside (three-dot menu). currently focus jumps to the end of the row. needs fix.

maya: agreed. keyboard behavior: Enter toggles expansion; Space opens the diff tooltip menu; Tab moves into row actions. document these in the keyboard shortcuts doc.

sam: that Space mapping might conflict with native page scrolling. keep it row-scoped only when row has aria-selected or focus.

kevin: implemented behavior should respect role="row" and only capture keys when the row element has tabindex=0. add aria-expanded on the row too.

leila: 3) legend visibility: legend takes too much space in compact mode. Proposed: collapse legend into an inline disclosure that reads "Legend (metrics)" and expands to show colors + pattern icons. the disclosure must be keyboard tabbable and have aria-controls.

maya: pattern icons are a must for colorblind users. reuse analytics patterns (diagonal/horizontal) and show both color + pattern. good to include alt text for each pattern e.g., "High severity (red, diagonal pattern)".

sam: 4) approval flow copy: primary CTA in the bulk toolbar is currently "Approve selected". suggestion: shorten to "Approve" and add secondary "Approve + leave note" so the path is explicit. modal on Approve should default to optional note unless team policy requires.

leila: i prefer keeping only one primary action to reduce cognitive load. maybe primary "Approve" and if team requires notes, make the modal enforce it. secondary action could be "Approve and add note" if we want explicitness.

kevin: implementation note: backend needs flag approveWithNote to surface the note immediately when user clicks secondary action. will add API ticket.

ux-bot: mock uploaded -> https://figma.com/file/xyz123/approve-variants (frame: approve-toolbar) :white_check_mark: 

maya: 5) badge language: on small screens show "Fail (3)" but on md+ show "3 regressions". avoid word "failed" which reads like a person failed. prefer neutral "regressions".

leila: also change color labels: instead of "Pass/Fail" use "Unchanged/Regressed" in the legend to be more descriptive.

sam: 6) thumbnails: maintain fixed aspect ratio and add 1px light border + 6px radius. avoid drop shadows that clash on dark mode. use a subtle inner stroke for dark mode.

kevin: will add css tokens for thumbnail container and pattern overlays.

maya: 7) empty state copy: current text: "No diffs — everything looks great!" -> change to "No regressions found". add CTA "Run test suite" and hint line "Press R to run (row must be focused)". include aria-live region when run starts.

leila: if keyboard run is triggered accidentally there should be a clear undo: show toast "Run queued" with "Undo" action for 4s.

sam: tiny copy nit: confirmation modal title: use sentence case "Approve test suite — add release note" (not Title Case). makes it read friendlier.

kevin: accessibility checklist for the PR: focus management for expand/collapse, aria-expanded and aria-controls on rows and disclosure, visible focus styles, keyboard-only flows for legend and approve modal, aria-live for run status, ESC to close popovers. I'll slot a spike to estimate.

maya: decisions summary i will put in PRD: - Keep primary CTA as "Approve" (add optional/required note in modal depending on team setting). - Add secondary "Approve + add note" (optional). - Row-focused keyboard handling: Enter toggles expand, Space opens menu (row-scoped), ensure focus lands on first action. - Legend collapsed into disclosure with color + pattern icons, aria labels. - Badge responsive copy: short on xs, expanded on md+. - Thumbnails: fixed aspect ratio + 1px border + radius; pattern overlays for regressions. - Empty state copy -> "No regressions found" + Run CTA + keyboard hint + undo toast. - Add visible focus outlines and reuse analytics pattern tokens.

ux-bot: PRD created: https://internal.redwood.ai/prd/eval-compact-access-1775557777 reviewers: @leila @kevin @sam

leila: i'll add final copy suggestions in the doc.

sam: :thumbsup: i'll coordinate a small usability pass next week.

kevin: tagging eng for estimate: can we get a 3-pt spike on keyboard focus/expand behaviors + dialog?

maya: thanks team, i'll push updated figma and PRD then follow up.

leila: :raised_hands:
